newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving with mixed trend.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving with mixed trend.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to remain mixed, but cement scrips may move up due to price rise of construction materials after Monday's cyclone that caused widespread destruction of houses in Bangladesh's coastal districts.

"The market is likely to remain active with both buying and selling. But the index may fall slightly on profit-taking by small investors after a week-long market rally," said broker Mohammad Sahidullah.
However, he said the cement scrips might gain as the prices of construction materials were rising sharply after the cyclone that also left 95 people dead and thousands of others homeless.
The DSE all-share price index closed 2.22 points or 0.17 percent up on turnover of 133.1 million taka on Tuesday. The market was closed on Wednesday due to a public holiday.
